name: io.github.ryanbiddy/uoink
description: Uoink keeps the videos, podcasts, and articles creators and AI developers study on their own disk, then hands them to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or a local MCP agent as a cited corpus.

install.notes: This catalog describes the 3.8.1 candidate; it is not the public installer. The published Windows download is 3.7.0 (339 MB, unsigned), with an unpacked browser extension. Follow /install for that release. Fresh installed-client checks for 3.8.1 are pending.

transports.note: Claude Desktop does not expand %LOCALAPPDATA%; use absolute paths or the generated setup config. Cline and Continue were not individually smoke-tested.
Local-only. Full tool registry. Token in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Uoink\token.txt.
OpenAPI 3.1 bridge for local agents that do not speak MCP.

platform: Windows 10/11 only. No Mac build scheduled.
